en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a quiet, slightly inclined street in a European city, lined with ornate residential buildings. On the left is a prominent half-timbered building with arched entrances labeled 'Cafe' and 'Restaurant.' The architecture is distinctly late 19th to early 20th century, with elaborate façades, bay windows, and decorative stonework. Two figures can be seen in the street, and the scene exudes early 20th-century charm.
